events.text: Aloha Nori! Getting organized for a busy January here in Honolulu (`Pacific/Honolulu` — remember Hawaiʻi has no daylight saving time, UTC-10 all year). I'm a Marine Conservation Program Manager at Pacific Reef Initiative, coordinating coral bleaching surveys and NOAA permit renewals across Oʻahu (Kāneʻohe Bay), Maui (Honolua Bay), and Kauaʻi (Hanalei). My field team is dive lead Kaiulani Nākānelua and Captain Keoni Kaleikini on the R/V Makani Kai. At home, my husband David and I are juggling two teens: Kai (16, logging his 50 supervised Hawaiʻi learner's permit hours — currently 14.5 daytime and 2.0 nighttime) and Mei (14, electrical lead on her FIRST Robotics team, Aloha Bots). One sacred rule to remember: I paddle outrigger canoe with my Hōkūleʻa training club every Tuesday and Thursday at 5:30 AM 🛶, so please never book or suggest meetings before 8:00 AM on Tuesdays or Thursdays.
